By combining these independent factors, systems drastically reduce the risk of unauthorized access even if a single password is compromised.

Title: Two-Factor Authentication Setup
FAQ: How do I set up two-factor authentication?

Two-factor authentication (2FA) adds an extra layer of security to your account. To enable 2FA, go to Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication and click Enable. We support authenticator apps (Google Authenticator, Authy) and SMS verification. Authenticator apps are recommended over SMS for stronger security. After enabling 2FA, you will be prompted for a verification code at each login.
--- End Document 2 ---

final_answer: Multi-factor authentication is a security method that requires two or more credentials to verify a user's identity. These credentials can be something you know (like a password), something you have (like a token), or something you are (like biometrics). By combining these independent factors, systems drastically reduce the risk of unauthorized access even if a single password is compromised. This multi-layered approach ensures robust defense against credential stuffing and brute-force attacks across modern enterprise architectures. (Source: Document 1)
